title: The path to first signal
description: The v1 critical path. Collecting ads depends on nothing and starts immediately; scaffolding through the corpus harness is the only thing standing between those ads and the human labelling task that gates both measurable extraction and elicitation.
caption: Heavy arrows are the critical path. T5 needs the candidate personally.

nodes.text:
T4b Collect 100 raw ads
ES / EN / CA, no labels

T1 Scaffold
uv, ruff, mypy, pytest

T4 Corpus harness
labelling CLI, split

T5 Label the corpus
**[HUMAN] — the bottleneck**
Everything numeric queues behind T5. Only the labelling needs judgement — collection does not, which is why it is split out and starts first.
